verdict.rationale: Veo's docs say it turns images into short videos and claim character consistency. That covers image-to-video, with a preservation claim. A hands-on report concretely contradicts the preservation part: Whisk's Veo 2 video generation redraws the entire source picture so the output barely resembles the original. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of subject/composition fidelity to the source image, independent corroboration that the input image is preserved, and resolution of the reported redraw behavior.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved

citations.quote: It excels at quickly turning text prompts and images into short videos
multi-input reasoning (supporting text, images, audio, and video inputs simultaneously), character consistency
